google_place_type_helper: Determines which type of places will be auto-fetched from Google for this category
refetch_nearby_places_description: This will re-fetch nearby places for this city from Google Places API. Existing places will be updated or added.
nearby_places_will_be_fetched_in_backgro: Nearby places will be fetched in the background and added to this city shortly.
commission_rate_property_type_helper: Leave blank to set the default rate applied to all property types without a specific rate.
delete_commission_rate_description: Are you sure you want to delete this commission rate? This cannot be undone.
no_commission_rates_description: Set a default commission rate for this country, or add property-type-specific rates. These rates are frozen on each booking at the time of creation.
delete_partner_override_description: Are you sure you want to delete this partner override? Future bookings will fall back to the default commission rate.
partner_override_description_helper: Note explaining why this partner has a custom rate (e.g. contract terms, special agreement).
partner_override_country_note: The partner list in the dropdown is filtered by the selected country. Any commission override applied here will affect only the selected partner within this country.
no_partner_overrides_description: Partner overrides let you set a custom commission rate for a specific partner, overriding the default rate for their property type.
default_commission_rate_description: Applied to all property types by default unless a specific rate is set.
default_rate_helper: This rate applies to all property types that do not have their own specific rate.
revert_to_default_description: This will remove the specific rate for this property type. Future bookings will use the country default commission rate instead.
no_property_types_for_commission: No active property types found. Add property types first to configure per-type commission rates.
commission_management_description: Manage platform commission rates at property type and partner levels.
commission_warning_default_title: Warning: Are you sure you want to change the default commission rate?
commission_warning_default_desc: Changing the default commission will affect all property types in this country that do not have a custom override.
commission_warning_type_title: Warning: Override the default commission for this property?
commission_warning_type_desc: This will affect all properties of this type in this country that do not have partner-level overrides.
delete_custom_commission_description: Are you sure? This property type will revert to the country's default commission rate.
default_rate_no_override: No custom rate to delete — this card uses the country default
approve_withdrawal_confirm: क्या आप इस निकासी अनुरोध को स्वीकृत करना चाहते हैं? राशि तुरंत वॉलेट से काटी जाएगी।
wallet_transactions_empty_description: आपकी बुकिंग पूरी होने के बाद वॉलेट क्रेडिट यहाँ दिखाई देंगे।
wallet_management_subtitle: Track wallet balances, credits, debits, and transaction history.
no_wallet_transactions: No wallet transactions for this property yet.
no_pending_settlements: No pending settlements — all check-ins are up to date.
property_approved_email_subject: आपकी संपत्ति को अनुमोदित कर दिया गया है – :app
property_approved_email_body: शुभ समाचार! आपकी संपत्ति की समीक्षा की गई और अनुमोदित कर दी गई है। यह अब अतिथियों के लिए उपलब्ध और दृश्यमान है।
property_approved_email_note: सुनिश्चित करें कि आपका उपलब्धता कैलेंडर अद्यतित है ताकि अतिथि तुरंत बुकिंग कर सकें।
property_correction_email_subject: कार्रवाई आवश्यक: आपकी संपत्ति में सुधार की आवश्यकता है – :app
property_correction_email_body: हमारी टीम ने आपकी संपत्ति सबमिशन की समीक्षा की और अनुमोदन से पहले कुछ बिंदुओं पर आपका ध्यान आवश्यक है।
property_rejected_email_body: दुर्भाग्यवश, आपकी संपत्ति सबमिशन की समीक्षा की गई और इसे इस समय अनुमोदित नहीं किया जा सका।
property_rejected_email_closing: यदि आपको लगता है कि यह निर्णय गलत है, तो कृपया हमारी सहायता टीम से संपर्क करें।
property_suspended_email_subject: आपकी संपत्ति को निलंबित कर दिया गया है – :app
property_suspended_email_body: आपकी संपत्ति को हमारी टीम द्वारा अस्थायी रूप से निलंबित कर दिया गया है और यह अतिथियों को अब दिखाई नहीं देती।
property_suspended_email_note: निलंबन समाप्त होने पर आपको सूचित किया जाएगा। किसी भी प्रश्न के लिए हमारी सहायता टीम से संपर्क करें।
property_suspended_cannot_edit: यह संपत्ति निलंबित है और इसे संपादित नहीं किया जा सकता।
initial_setup_description: Choose how you want to manage your properties.
choose_country_property_located: Choose the country where your property is located.
what_type_of_property: What type of property will you manage on this platform?
provide_personal_information: Provide your personal information to create your Partner Account.
jpg_png_square_best: JPG or PNG, square works best, up to 5 MB.
use_name_on_government_id: Use the name printed on your government ID.
click_map_drag_pin: Click the map or drag the pin to fine-tune the exact location.
provide_required_documentation: Please provide the required documentation for your country.
all_set_click_finish: You're all set! Click "Finish Setup" to continue.
valid_email_required: Please enter a valid email address.
email_already_registered: This email is already registered to another account.
legal_documents_compliance_details: Provide the necessary legal documents and compliance details.
search_by_user_id_or_email: यूजर ID या ईमेल से खोजें
fill_all_smtp_settings_to_test: Please fill all essential SMTP fields first.
smtp_password_helper: If using Gmail or Outlook with 2-Step Verification, use an App Password instead of your regular password.
google_maps_browser_key_helper: For the map picker. Google Cloud: HTTP referrer restriction; allow Maps JavaScript API + Places API (New).
google_places_server_key_helper: For nearby-places search. Google Cloud: IP restriction; allow Places API (New) only.
ipinfo_api_key_helper: Get your free token from ipinfo.io. Leave empty to use the free anonymous tier (rate-limited).
crontab_entry_description: Paste the crontab entry below on a new line, save and exit. Wait 1-2 minutes, then the tasks will start running automatically.
scheduled_tasks_description: These run automatically every minute once the cron is set up. You can also run any of them manually right now.
task_schedule_run_desc: Master task — fires everything below that is due (this is what the server cron calls).
task_queue_work_desc: Drains all pending background jobs: emails, push notifications, nearby places fetching, etc.
task_inventory_locks_desc: Releases reserved inventory locks for bookings that took too long to complete payment.
task_ghost_bookings_desc: Cleans up stuck or abandoned bookings that were never completed.
task_reconcile_pending_desc: Checks payment gateways to confirm status of pending payments.
task_marketing_messages_desc: Sends out scheduled push notifications and emails.
task_credit_checked_in_desc: Credits partner wallets for bookings that have checked in.
task_sync_exchange_desc: Updates global currency exchange rates via API.
demo_account_action_not_allowed: डेमो खाते के लिए यह कार्रवाई की अनुमति नहीं है।
